annotations.text:
A — Terminal / CLI (dark)
Photo as a "portrait.png" file preview in the sidebar. Projects are a scrollable row of file cards. Chat launcher bottom-right. Title rotates through your four target roles.

A — Terminal / CLI (light) — chosen direction
Type a command into "user@devops:~$" at the bottom (e.g. "cd projects") + Enter, click a nav line, or use Up/Down. Rotating remote/hybrid/relocation status now sits at the top of the sidebar.

C — Blueprint / Schematic
Photo as a numbered "FIG. 1" specimen box. Projects are a scrollable strip of numbered sheets. Chat launcher styled as an engineering "detail callout". Same rotating title.
